description: Erection of part single storey rear extension with roof lantern and pergola; alterations to windows at the rear; erection of three rear dormer windows and one roof window; installation of four front roof windows; enlargement of side lean-to extension;  installation of five solar panels on the side roof; provision for metal railing in Victorian style to the front.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & access statement, location plan, flood risk assessment, 1447-EX06, 05, 1447-ex30, 1447-ex50, 1447-ex10, 1447-EX20, 1447-EX00, 1447-EX02, 1447-EX04, 1447-EX03, 1447-EX01, 1447-Ex40 Received: 05/04/2022; Fire statement Received: 26/04/2022; 1447-02-A, 1447-03-A, 1447-04-A, 1447-05-A, 1447-20-A, 1447-30-A, 1447-60-A Received: 12/05/2022; 1447-01-B, 1447-40-B & 1447-50-B, Received: 07/07/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - Once the solar PV or solar equipment hereby permitted has reached the end of their lifetime they should be removed as soon as reasonably practicable.
